title: A method for simulating forward falls and controlling impact velocity
author: Borrelli, Creath, et al.

steps.title: Set up mats and force platforms
steps.instruction: Place two gymnastic mats (North Carolina Gym Supply, Hillsborough, NC) on the floor, each directly over a force platform (AMTI, Watertown, MA). Position the support platform so that its top surface aligns with the mats and can be released unpredictably.

steps.title: Position participant for fall
steps.instruction: Seat the participant with ankles plantar‑flexed, hands resting on the top of the support platform, shoulders approximately 12 inches above the platform, and lean forward to the designated initial angle (or counterweight condition). Ensure the starting posture requires rapid hand/arm orientation before impact.

steps.title: Select random experimental condition
steps.instruction: For Experiment 1, randomly choose one of four initial lean angles: Low 65 ± 3°, Medium 52 ± 3°, Medium‑High 45 ± 3°, or High 39 ± 3°, with no counterweight. For Experiment 2, randomly choose one of four counterweight loads: Small 6.8 ± 0.4 %BW, Medium 12.4 ± 0.8 %BW, Medium‑Large 17.9 ± 1.1 %BW, or Large 29.1 ± 1.7 %BW, while keeping the initial angle constant at 37 ± 1° from vertical.

steps.title: Perform familiarization trial
steps.instruction: Before the first two experimental trials, have the participant complete a single familiarization fall using the same initial lean angle or counterweight load that will be used in those trials.

steps.title: Run simulated forward fall trials
steps.instruction: For Experiment 1, conduct eight simulated forward falls: two trials at each of the four initial angles (Low, Medium, Medium‑High, High) with no counterweight. For Experiment 2, conduct eight simulated forward falls: two trials at each of the four counterweight levels (Small, Medium, Medium‑Large, Large) starting from the constant angle of 37 ± 1°. Allow up to a 2‑minute break between each trial to minimize fatigue. Instruct the participant to “land on their hands as softly as possible” for every trial.

steps.title: Release support platform
steps.instruction: At an unpredictable moment during each trial, release the support platform so the participant falls forward onto the mats and force platforms.
